title: Adaptive Data Collection for Latin-American Community-sourced Evaluation of Stereotypes (LACES)

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models using BBQ-style multiple-choice questions constructed from community-sourced (nationality, attribute) pairs. The models are prompted to associate a stereotypical attribute with a specific nationality (or choose an 'Unknown' option), and a bias score is calculated based on the frequency of stereotypical predictions. The paper also tests zero-shot self-debiasing techniques (explanation and reprompting) to measure mitigation effectiveness.
